notes: Nhat ky loi detail modal ('Chi tiet ban ghi') showed record_status (CHINH THUC/da huy) but never the underlying task workflow state, so there was no way to tell if a record was waiting on the employee, being explained, or overdue. Added getChecklistViolationTaskStatus (lib/checklist-violations.js): loads the violation row, reuses requireViolationPermission(session,'view',[record]) unchanged (same permission as the rest of the detail modal - no new permission logic), then reads the latest linked checklist_violation_tasks row by violation_id. Returns task:null (not an error) when a record has no linked task (cancelled/draft before task creation, or pre-dates the task system). Wired as a new action on the existing /api/data endpoint (server.js + api/data.js parity). Frontend: loadViolationTaskStatus fetches alongside history/evidence when the modal opens; violationTaskStatusCellHtml renders a new 'Tinh trang xu ly' cell reusing the existing taskStatusLabel() copy (same labels already used in Viec can xu ly - Cho nhan vien / Cho nguoi ghi phan hoi / Cho nhan vien xac nhan ket luan / Cho Admin / Hoan tat / Da huy), with a due-date line and a single new CSS rule (.is-overdue color, reusing the established overdue red) when the task is open and past due. Hidden for cancelled records. Added scripts/test-checklist-violation-task-status.js covering not-found, no-linked-task, and the real permission gate (admin bypass, employee viewing own vs another employee's record).
